name: pair
purpose: One row of a worked example: input cells, an arrow and the answer, for example [18] → 47. The parts come in one by one.

cells.doc: the input cells, one to six; {path} takes a state value

to.doc: the answer at the end of the arrow

heads.doc: two small labels above the cells and above the answer, for the first row

n.doc: a number in a circle at the start of the row
